meta.description: Applies formal change management to a production network.

question.text: A technician plans to update a core switch during business hours. Which process should be followed before making the change?
options: Submit the change for the required review and approval, including impact and rollback planning
Make the change immediately and document it only if it fails
Disable monitoring so the change is not interrupted
Ask an unrelated end user to approve it verbally after completion
correctAnswers: Submit the change for the required review and approval, including impact and rollback planning
